meta.title: OpenWithin — Close your eyes. Open your world.
meta.description: Personalized guided meditations, relaxation, Yoga Nidra and visualizations created around you — your name, your voice preferences, your inner world.

footer.tagline: Personalized guided experiences, created around you. Close your eyes. Open your world.
footer.disclaimer: OpenWithin is a tool for relaxation, imagination and self-reflection. It is not a medical device, does not provide therapy and does not replace professional care. Do not listen while driving.

home.eyebrow: Your personal space, guided by a voice
home.heroTitle: Close your eyes. Open your world.
home.heroSubtitle: Personalized guided experiences, created around you.
home.heroNote: Hear a free 15-second preview with your name — no account needed.
home.story4: An experience made for you begins.
home.createSubtitle: A few gentle questions. Then you'll hear the first seconds of a session written for you.
home.knowsEyebrow: One voice. Your story. Your inner world.
home.knowsTitle: Not just a voice. A voice that knows your story.
home.knowsBody: Most audio sessions are recorded once for thousands of listeners. OpenWithin is shaped around one person: the voice, the narration, the length, the silences, the music — and only the personal details you choose to share.

voice.title: Voice
voice.body: Choose a narrator whose tone feels right — soft, warm or deep.

narration.title: Narration
narration.body: Written for your technique, in your language, never translated word for word.

duration.title: Duration
duration.body: Five minutes between meetings or forty-five before sleep.

pauses.title: Pauses
pauses.body: Real, measured silence — rendered by the audio engine, not by punctuation.

music.title: Sound
music.body: Rain, waves, wind, soft tones or nothing but the voice.

details.title: Your details
details.body: Your name, a place you love, an intention — always optional, always yours to delete.

space.name: Space
space.body: When you close your eyes, the outside world steps back and a much larger inner space appears.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.body: A calm voice leads you through carefully structured techniques — from Yoga Nidra to Jacobson.

personalization.name: Personalization
personalization.body: Every session is built from your preferences and context — so it feels created for you, not generated for everyone.

how1.title: Choose an experience
how1.body: Relaxation, meditation, visualization, sleep or a programme.

how2.title: Tell us a little
how2.body: Your name and a few optional preferences. No diagnosis, no long forms.

how3.title: Hear your preview
how3.body: 15 real seconds, spoken for you, in your language.

how4.title: Unlock the full session
how4.body: Sign in and your first full experience (up to 5 minutes) is free.

home.studioTitle: Turn your expertise into personalized audio experiences your clients can use anytime.
home.studioBody: For psychologists, coaches, yoga teachers and mindfulness trainers. Write or edit the script, choose the voice, publish in minutes — no external shop needed.

arrival.name: Arrival
arrival.body: The voice greets you by name and helps you settle into a comfortable position.

breath_settle.name: Settling the breath
breath_settle.body: Noticing the natural breath without changing it, letting each exhale soften the body.

breath_pattern.name: Counted breathing
breath_pattern.body: A steady rhythm counted for you, with real timed silences — and never long breath-holds.

body_scan.name: Body scan
body_scan.body: Attention travels slowly from the feet to the head, with longer pauses where you hold tension.

pmr_group.name: Tension & release
pmr_group.body: Gently tensing one muscle group for a few seconds, then a long, quiet release.

intention.name: Intention
intention.body: A short personal intention (sankalpa), repeated silently in your own words.

rotation.name: Rotation of awareness
rotation.body: The voice names points of the body one by one; attention simply follows.

opposites.name: Opposites
opposites.body: Sensing heaviness and lightness, warmth and coolness — observing without holding on.

imagery_place.name: Your place
imagery_place.body: Imagery of the setting you chose — its light, sounds and stillness.

imagery_goal.name: Your goal
imagery_goal.body: A calm, concrete rehearsal of the moment you are working towards, and the steps on the way.

imagery_confidence.name: Steady confidence
imagery_confidence.body: Walking through the situation ahead: posture, breath, first words, and what to do if the unexpected happens.

future_self.name: Future self
future_self.body: Meeting a calmer, wiser version of yourself and listening to what they might say.

safe_place.name: Calm inner place
safe_place.body: Building a comfortable inner space detail by detail, with an anchor to return to.

awareness.name: Open awareness
awareness.body: Resting with sounds, thoughts and the body as a whole — noticing without judging.

gratitude.name: Gratitude
gratitude.body: Recalling small good moments and noticing how they feel in the body.

energize.name: Gentle energy
energize.body: Deeper breaths and small movements to wake the body for the day.

reflection.name: Reflection
reflection.body: Quiet questions with space to listen to your own answers.

sleep_descent.name: Drifting down
sleep_descent.body: Slower words, longer silences and a soft countdown towards rest.

integration.name: Integration
integration.body: A moment to notice how you feel now, without needing it to be any particular way.

return.name: Gentle return
return.body: Deepening the breath, moving fingers and toes, and opening the eyes when ready.

sleep_close.name: Fade to rest
sleep_close.body: The voice fades into ambient sound. There is no wake-up at the end.

landing.point1: A real 15-second preview with your name, free and without an account
landing.point2: Written for this technique, in English, Polish or Spanish
landing.point3: Your voice, pace, length, pauses and background sound
landing.flowSubtitle: Structure of a {minutes}-minute session. Longer sessions add more silence, not more words.
landing.safetyNote: You can pause or stop at any time. If any part feels uncomfortable, skip it or choose a simpler version. OpenWithin is a relaxation practice, not a medical treatment.

create.title: Choose an experience
create.subtitle: Every technique has its own structure and questions. Start with the one that calls you.

explore.title: Experiences
explore.subtitle: Relaxation, meditation, visualization and sleep — each one created around you.
explore.programsSubtitle: Short series that build gently from day to day.

programs.noPressure: Go at your own pace. Missing a day is fine — the programme waits for you.
programs.creditsNote: Each new day uses one session from your plan or pack. Listening again is always free.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Start free. Unlock longer sessions, packs or a monthly plan when you're ready.
plans.note: Prices include VAT where applicable. Recordings stay in your library; replaying them is always free. If a generation fails you are never charged.

checkout.demoNotice: Demo mode: no payment provider is configured, so this simulates a successful test payment. With Stripe keys set, real Stripe Checkout (test mode) is used.

profile.title: Personalization profile
profile.subtitle: Everything here is optional. You decide what may be used, and you can delete it anytime.
profile.invalid: Some text could not be saved. Please avoid links and contact details.
profile.level_deep: Deep — may use allowed personal context
profile.levelHint: Personal context is never used in breathing or muscle relaxation sessions, and never more than twice per session.
profile.contextBody: Motivations, aspirations, people or memories you'd like your sessions to draw on. Each item is used only in the categories you tick.
profile.labelPlaceholder: A few words, e.g. "walks by the sea"
profile.contextWarning: Please don't add health information. When mentioning other people — especially children — use only a first name or a role, and only what they'd be comfortable with. Memories marked mixed are never used.
profile.remindersBody: Optional, at a time you choose. No streaks and no guilt if you skip a day.
profile.marketing: Send me occasional emails about new experiences (optional)
profile.privacyBody: Export everything we store about you, delete your personalization profile, or delete your account and recordings.
profile.confirmWipeProfile: Delete your personalization profile and personal context? Your recordings stay.
profile.confirmDelete: Delete your account and all recordings permanently? This cannot be undone.

store.consent: I want access immediately and acknowledge that I lose my right of withdrawal once the digital content has been delivered.
store.delivery: Your personalized sessions are generated right after payment and appear in your space.

marketing.title: Turn your expertise into personalized audio experiences your clients can use anytime.
marketing.subtitle: OpenWithin Studio lets psychologists, coaches, yoga teachers and mindfulness trainers create guided audio that speaks to each client by name — and publish it in minutes.
marketing.point1: Start from a technique template or write your own script — edit every sentence and every pause.
marketing.point2: Choose the voice, language, background sound and narrator instructions; hear a sample before publishing.
marketing.point3: Publish a single experience or a multi-day programme with a price and a shareable link.
marketing.point4: Each buyer personalizes it and receives their own recording — no external shop, no CRM integration.
marketing.point5: Psychologists and psychotherapists can share privately with clients, without selling.
marketing.pricing: Starter Studio is free with a commission on sales. Studio Pro lowers the commission for a monthly fee.
marketing.responsibility: You remain responsible for the content you publish. Products may not be presented as therapy or treatment, and every publication passes an automated safety check with human review where needed.

compose.title: Create an experience

compose.composerNote: No LLM key configured: the script is composed from OpenWithin's built-in, technique-specific templates. You can edit everything.
compose.name: Working title

compose.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Use simple language, mention the breath often, avoid water imagery.
compose.instructionsHint: Used when writing the script. Never include client data or therapy notes.

editor.help: Edit any sentence, pause or order. Placeholders like '{{name}}', '{{place}}' or '{{intention}}' are filled for each client; sentences whose placeholder has no answer are skipped. Keep '{{name}}' in the first segment.
editor.issue_missing_phase: A required part of the technique is missing
editor.issue_phase_order: Parts are out of the technique's order
editor.issue_language_mismatch: The text doesn't seem to be in the selected language
editor.issue_medical_claim: Contains a medical or therapeutic claim
editor.issue_unsafe_technique: Mentions a technique that requires specialist guidance
editor.issue_wake_in_sleep: A sleep session should not end with a wake-up
editor.issue_name_overuse: The name is used too often
editor.issue_too_many_chars: The script is too long for its duration
editor.sampleHint: The first ~45 seconds, spoken with this name.
editor.sample_sample_quota: Monthly sample limit reached for your plan.
